chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Ike Quebec and the Blue Note session
summary: Blue Note arranged for him to record with Ike Quebec, a friend from Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When did you first meet Ike Quebec?

... The studio, Blue Note, arranged that we record together, but he and I knew each other, we used to hang out together -- went to Atlantic City. He was a good friend, man. We got things together and had a good session...
